instrument_provenance.register-metrics.mjs: run UNMODIFIED; CLI <label=path>; emits HFD/LMV/LDR/SAT_mean/SAT_std/HLF_pct/SHF_pct over 960w-grayscale+HSV. Source of HLF + LMV anchor values.
instrument_provenance.spell-motion-score.mjs: the LOCKED time-sequence instrument is HARDCODED to a 7-frame Godot sequence + takes NO CLI args + isolates the spell by ADDITIVE-FLOOR temporal subtraction. It STRUCTURALLY CANNOT ingest single genre stills. Run UNMODIFIED on its OWN native sequence (the existing Godot V0 descent fire-cast) to capture its self-reported axis values as the GODOT-V0-BASELINE data point (see godot_v0_baseline below).
instrument_provenance.ladder-anchor-still-probe.mjs: NEW read-only sidecar (does NOT modify the locked instrument). Computes spell-motion's hue-legibility (fire-band frac) + layering-variance (local-luma-std) primitives VERBATIM, on single stills, via a HIGHLIGHT-LUMA gate (luma>=158) since a single still has no temporal floor to subtract. Source of the still-anchored hue-legibility + layering-variance marks.

CRITICAL_instrument_boundary.reason: energy-travel + motion-presence + directionality are INHERENTLY TEMPORAL — a single genre still has NO time axis, so there is no defensible way to anchor a tier-mark for them from stills. This is an honest v0.1 instrument-maturity boundary, surfaced not papered-over. For these 3 axes, Wave 2 scores drax's frame-SEQUENCES on their own (V1 vs V0 DELTA), and the GODOT-V0-BASELINE below is the only available reference point — which is appropriate, because the spec's PRIMARY signal for these axes IS the V1-V0 delta, not an absolute genre anchor.

HLF_highlight_bloom.metric: register-metrics HLF_pct (% px luma>0.80) — the additive-emissive glow lever that scored 5/5 at register-lock
HLF_highlight_bloom.tier_mark_rationale: T1<=0.15: the fire-claw-mixed frame (fire present but restrained) + non-combat cutscene sit here = 'coherent VFX present but not bloom-driven'. T2 FLOOR=0.6: the fire-combat-lava + LE-02-dungeon-spellarc (genuine D2-class legible-juiced fire) anchor the genre-competent floor. T2.8=1.1: golden-dome (strong additive fire bloom). T3=2.85: TLI-01 golden-ritual (the VFX-as-everything ceiling). T3-EXTREME (TLI-02 loot-explosion 7.40) is loot-screen saturation, NOT a single-spell target — do NOT hold a single fire-cast to it.
HLF_highlight_bloom.verdict_note: drax V1 PASSES the HLF half of the juice gate at HLF >= 0.6 (T2 floor). The HEADLINE read is V1-HLF vs V0-HLF: a LARGE positive delta = the emission/post lever works (cheap fix); a SMALL delta = structural cap.

LMV_layering_depth.metric: register-metrics LMV (mean per-tile luma std, 8x8 grid) — flat-billboard (low) vs richly-layered (high). PAIRED with layering-variance below.
LMV_layering_depth.tier_mark_rationale: WHOLE-FRAME LMV — includes scene geometry not just the spell, so reads higher than the spell-region-only layering-variance below. T1<=17: fire-claw-mixed. T2 FLOOR=21: LE-02-dungeon (genre-competent painted/layered scene). T3=28: the TLI/PoE-fire premium cluster (golden-dome 28.8, fire-lava 27.7). NOTE: a Godot frame on a NEUTRAL GREY stage (spec §3) will have LOW whole-frame LMV by construction (the grey background is flat) — so for drax's frames, the spell-region layering-variance below is the cleaner read; whole-frame LMV is reported for transparency but interpret with the grey-stage caveat.

layering_variance_spell_region.metric: spell-motion M4 analog (still-probe): mean local-luma-std INSIDE the bright-VFX region (HI-gate luma>=158). The flat-billboard signature INVERTED — core+glow-gradient+particle-scatter = HIGH; flat saturated billboard = LOW.
layering_variance_spell_region.godot_v0_baseline_spellmotion_M4: 7.4 - 11.8 (peak 11.8 at impact-onset) — the existing Godot descent fire-cast, scored by the LOCKED spell-motion-score.mjs on its native sequence
layering_variance_spell_region.tier_mark_rationale: T1<=11: a smooth single-billboard bloom (TLI-01 golden-ritual is a SMOOTH wash = 12.0, deliberately low-variance — a NUANCE: high-bloom can be low-layering; the eye reads 'one glowing disc'). T2 FLOOR=18: golden-dome (layered core+falloff). T3=24: the fireball-burst (24.8 — many discrete fire-bolts = high spell-region variance). The Godot V0 baseline (7.4-11.8) currently sits AT/BELOW T1 on this axis — meaning V0 reads as a near-flat additive billboard. The V1 sub-emitter (ember/spark layer) is EXACTLY the move that should lift this toward T2; the V1-V0 delta on spell-region layering-variance is a key Wave-2 read.
layering_variance_spell_region.interpretation_caveat: Higher spell-region variance is NOT monotonically 'better' — fire-claw-mixed reads 37.5 (highest) because its bright region is small + jagged + small-px (0.29% of frame). Read this axis WITH the gate-px size; a tiny jagged spell can spuriously score high. Wave 2 reports gate-px alongside.

hue_legibility_fire.metric: spell-motion M3 analog (still-probe): fraction of WARM-bright spell pixels in the fire hue-band (0-50 deg). Element must read unambiguously as FIRE.
hue_legibility_fire.godot_v0_baseline_spellmotion_M3: 0.30 - 0.51 (peak 0.51 at impact F06) — existing Godot descent fire-cast, LOCKED spell-motion-score.mjs on native sequence. NOTE: V0 baseline peak (0.51) is BELOW the genre fire-exemplar floor (0.66) — the existing Godot fire reads LESS unambiguously fire than genre fire.
hue_legibility_fire.tier_mark_rationale: T1<=0.50: the Godot-V0 peak (0.51) + the non-fire purple-beam (0.47, included as a NON-fire reference floor — a purple spell scores low on the fire-band by design, confirming the metric discriminates element). T2 FLOOR=0.66: the PoE fire-exemplar cluster (0.66-0.73 — genuine legible fire in a busy scene). T3=0.88: LE-02-dungeon-spellarc (0.88) + TLI-01-golden-ritual (0.94 — a pure warm bloom, maximally fire-legible). The fire test subject must clear T2 (0.66) for gandalf's 'hue-legibility >= T2' non-negotiable.
hue_legibility_fire.scene_vs_isolated_caveat: These warmHI-gate fractions are measured on FULL COMBAT SCENES (other warm props/fires contaminate the warm-bright region). drax's frame is ONE fire-spell on NEUTRAL GREY — its warmHI region is PURELY the spell, so its fire-band-frac should read HIGHER + cleaner than these scene anchors if the spell hue is genuinely fire. i.e. a Godot fire-spell on grey scoring BELOW 0.66 would be a real hue-legibility failure, not a scene-contamination artifact.
